title: A reviewer's answer
description: Every line of the batch, once: kept, or replaced with a reason.

keep.description: Whether the translation stands as it is.

en.description: Your English when keep is false; null when it's true.

reason.description: One short sentence on what was wrong when keep is false; null when it's true.

by_chance.description: When keep is false: the glossary's names, in Chinese, that the line holds only by chance and your English leaves out; only on a line that has any.
